entities.name: Lukáš Kašpar

entities.summary: Lukáš Kašpar is a Czech former professional ice hockey player. He last played for HC Kometa Brno of the Czech Extraliga (ELH). He was originally drafted by the San Jose Sharks in the first round of the 2004 NHL Entry Draft.
